name: ladder-placement
comment: BlockLadder: ladders at meta 2..5 on the four sides of a stone block (2, 61, 2), a two-high ladder on a two-high stone column, and a ladder at meta 3 (wanting a normal cube at z-1) whose only neighbouring cube is at z+1. t=3 removes the centre stone: each of the four ladders' onNeighborBlockChange drops it (item first, then setBlockWithNotify). t=5 removes the lower stone of the column: only the lower ladder drops. t=7 sets stone above the mis-attached ladder: it drops. block_box, the drops' entity state, rng_state.
